absence_scope: Official subject category mapped to ADE20K; animal is a generic animal region, not species recognition or instance verification. Train remains unsupported. Coarse semantic input review required; no missing frame is proof the subject is absent.
unsupported_policy: Reject categories not explicitly mapped. Do not map individual animal species to ADE20K animal or infer subjects from a prompt.
recovery_description: Second GrabCut uses existing construction foreground cores and uncertain regions extending to each connected component bounding box plus 25% of its longest side. Fixed before new recovered-variant scores; no SAM scoring masks or DINO scores.
fallback_description: If the optional recovery lacks certain seeds or leaves the original 1%-50% area range, keep the valid initial SegFormer+GrabCut mask for that frame and explicitly record fallback. Never replace an initially valid mask with fabricated emptiness.
